premise: Hide-and-seek: Hedgehog hides so well that nobody can find him, until a snore gives him away and everybody joins the nap.
inspiration: Folk hide-and-seek games and the sleeper-who-gives-himself-away joke, turned: finding him means joining him.
lesson: The best hiding place is one with room for friends.

en-US.title: The Snoring Hiding Place
en-US.text: {tree:sway loop 0.3} Hide-and-seek! Fox was counting. One, two, three... Rabbit {rabbit:hop x3} hopped behind a fern. Mouse {mouse:puff} slipped under a leaf. And Hedgehog trotted off to the best hiding place he knew. Ten! Ready or not! Fox {fox:hop} found Rabbit first. Fox found Mouse next. Then, Hedgehog. Behind the log? No. Under the roots? No. In the leaves? Only leaves. Fox {fox:wobble x2} scratched his head. They looked and looked. The sun got low and warm and sleepy. Then... a sound. Small and rumbly. Hrrr... phew. Hrrr... phew. Rabbit's ears went up. What's that? They followed it. Into a hollow full of soft dry moss. And there was Hedgehog, {hedgehog:pulse} curled up, {hedgehog:shake 0.3} snoring. Found you, whispered Fox. Hedgehog didn't wake up. He {fox:fade-out hold} lay down. Rabbit {rabbit:fade-out hold} lay down. Mouse {mouse:fade-out hold} lay down. Hrrr... phew. Best hiding place ever.

es-ES.title: El escondite que ronca
es-ES.text: {tree:sway loop 0.3} ¡Al escondite! Zorro contaba. Uno, dos, tres... Conejo {rabbit:hop x3} saltó detrás de un helecho. Ratón {mouse:puff} se metió bajo una hoja. Y Erizo se fue trotando al mejor escondite que conocía. ¡Diez! ¡Que voy! Zorro {fox:hop} encontró primero a Conejo. Luego encontró a Ratón. Luego, Erizo. ¿Detrás del tronco? No. ¿Bajo las raíces? No. ¿Entre las hojas? Solo hojas. Zorro {fox:wobble x2} se rascó la cabeza. Buscaron y buscaron. El sol bajó, cálido y soñoliento. Y entonces... un sonido. Pequeño y ronco. Jrrr... fiu. Jrrr... fiu. A Conejo se le levantaron las orejas. ¿Qué es eso? Lo siguieron. Hasta un hueco lleno de musgo seco y blandito. Y allí estaba Erizo, {hedgehog:pulse} hecho una bola, {hedgehog:shake 0.3} roncando. Te encontré, susurró Zorro. Erizo no se despertó. {fox:fade-out hold} Se tumbó. Conejo {rabbit:fade-out hold} se tumbó. Ratón {mouse:fade-out hold} se tumbó. Jrrr... fiu. El mejor escondite del mundo.

sound.note: a tiny cosy snore, in and out
